title: Score32 exact banked finalized-tree c16 bank PPA baseline
hypothesis: The legacy exact pair-merge exp-scale encoding is physically infeasible in this banked-tree envelope because each of the 15 pair nodes infers an oversized dual-read exact exp LUT. The exact factored replacement proved bit-exact and removed that memory guard, but the flat c16 tree plus ordered banked finalizer composition still overran the evaluator tool envelope at Yosys techmap. The next measurable frontier is therefore hierarchical decomposition into standalone factored tree scaling and standalone ordered-bank control scaling, which can later be recomposed with separate exact-finalizer arithmetic PPA.
